name: Highway Car Racing
summary:
Welcome to Highway Car Racing, an exciting racing game where speed, skill, and precision determine who reaches the finish line first. Take control of powerful cars and compete in thrilling races across a variety of tracks designed to challenge drivers of all skill levels.
